y-m-77-01.title: Hubinta tirooyinka warbixinta xawaaraha gaarsiinta safarka-tagista-iyo-soo-laabashada
y-m-77-01.goal: Ku hubi xisaabin in xawaaraha celceliska safarka tagista-iyo-soo-laabashada uusan la simanayn celceliska fudud ee labada xawaare, oo sheeg goorta ay isle'eg yihiin.
y-m-77-01.material: Darawal gaarsiin ayaa sameeyey safar tagista-iyo-soo-laabashada oo masaafadiisu hal dhinac tahay 12 km. Marka uu tagay, darawalku wuxuu ku socday 30 km saacaddii, marka uu soo laabtay na, 20 km saacaddii (u qaad joojin la'aan iyo xawaare joogto ah lug kasta). Warbixinta saaxiib shaqo ayaa sidan u xisaabisay.
y-m-77-01.thinking.0: Hel sadarka warbixinta ee sabab la'aan lagu boodayo
y-m-77-01.thinking.1: Hubi qiimaha adigoo isticmaalaya qeexidda wadarka masaafada iyo wadarka waqtiga
y-m-77-01.thinking.2: Samee dhowr lammaane xawaare oo buuxiya shuruudaha
y-m-77-01.prereq.0: Hawshan, 'H3' waa calaamad keliya oo adkaanta iyo heerka taageerada qaybintan wax-soo-saarka. Macnaheedu maaha in Wasaaradda Waxbarashadu maadadan ku meelayso fasal gaar ah. U qaad in xisaabta xirfadda dugsiga sare loo qaadanayo adkaan sare, oo aad horey u taqaan saamiyada, boqolkiiba, celcelisyada, iyo tibaaxaha xarfaha ee heerka dugsiga dhexe.
y-m-77-01.prereq.1: Xawaaraha = masaafada ÷ waqtiga, macnaha celceliska (heerka dugsiga dhexe)
y-m-77-01.s.s1.prompt: Dooro hal sadar oo shaqada saaxiibkaa ah oo aan taageero lahayn ama khaldan.
y-m-77-01.s.s1.hint.0: Sadar kasta, kala saar haddii ay si fudud u wadato shuruudaha dhibaatada (masaafada, xawaaraha) mise ay sheegayso sheegasho cusub.
y-m-77-01.s.s1.hint.1: Hel waqtiga tagista iyo waqtiga soo laabashada, qor wadarka, oo qiimahaas dhinac dhinac dhig xisaabinta waqtiga ee warbixinta si aad u isbarbar dhigto.
y-m-77-01.s.s1.line.0: Tagista: ku socodsii 12 km 30 km saacaddii.
y-m-77-01.s.s1.line.1: Soo laabashada: dib ugu soo laabo 12 km 20 km saacaddii.
y-m-77-01.s.s1.line.2: Xawaaraha celcelisku waa celceliska labada xawaare, sidaa darteed (30+20)÷2 = 25 km/h.
y-m-77-01.s.s1.line.3: Safarka tagista-iyo-soo-laabashada ee 24 km waxaa lagu samayn karaa 25 km saacaddii, sidaa darteed waqtiga qaatay waa 24÷25 = 0.96 saacadood.
y-m-77-01.s.s1.explain: Sadarrada 1 iyo 2 si fudud ayay u wadaan shuruudaha, sidaa darteed waa sax. Sadarka 3 waa halka dhibaatadu ka bilaabato. Xawaaraha celcelisku waa 'wadarka masaafada ÷ wadarka waqtiga', laakiin inkasta oo waqtiyada tagista iyo soo laabashada ay kala duwan yihiin, labada xawaare si siman ayaa loo celceliyey. Dhab ahaan, tagistu waxay qaadataa 12÷30=0.4 saacadood soo laabashada na 12÷20=0.6 saacadood, sidaa darteed safarka oo dhan wuxuu qaadanayaa 1 saacad, xawaaraha celcelisku na waa 24÷1=24 km/h. Sadarka 4 wuxuu isticmaalaa 25 ee sadarka 3 sida uu yahay, taasoo siinaysa waqti khaldan oo 0.96 saacadood ah. Haddii aad dooratay sadarka 3 ama sadarka 4, waxaad aragtay sadar khaldan, laakiin sababtu waa sadarka 3.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.prompt: U qaad isla waddada la safray xawaare a km saacaddii tagista iyo b km saacaddii soo laabashada. Samee laba lammaane oo kala duwan (a, b) oo xawaaraha celceliska safarka oo dhan (wadarka masaafada ÷ wadarka waqtiga) uu yahay tiro dabiici ah. a iyo b waa tirooyin dabiici ah oo kala duwan laga bilaabo 10 ilaa 100, masaafada hal dhinac na muhiim ma aha. (30, 20) horey ayaa loo bixiyey sida tusaale, sidaa darteed ka reeb. (a, b) iyo (b, a) waxaa loo tiriyaa isla tusaale.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.hint.0: Dhig masaafada hal dhinac 12 km, oo (a, b) kasta oo musharrax ah, hel waqtiga tagista iyo waqtiga soo laabashada oo isku dar.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.hint.1: Dhowr lammaane oo musharrax ah, ku habee shax haddii wadarka masaafada loo qaybiyey wadarka waqtiga uu yahay tiro dabiici ah, oo eeg waxa lammaanayaasha siinaya tiro dabiici ah ay wadaagaan.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.ok.c1: a iyo b waa tirooyin dabiici ah laga bilaabo 10 ilaa 100.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Fadlan a iyo b ka dhig tirooyin dabiici ah laga bilaabo 10 ilaa 100.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.ok.c2: Labada xawaare way kala duwan yihiin.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Xawaaraha tagista iyo soo laabashada waa inay kala duwan yihiin.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.fail.c3: (30, 20) horey ayaa loo bixiyey sida tusaale. Isku day inaad hesho lammaane kale.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.ok.c4: Xawaaraha celceliska safarka tagista-iyo-soo-laabashada waa tiro dabiici ah.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.fail.c4: Xawaaraha celceliska safarka tagista-iyo-soo-laabashada maaha tiro dabiici ah. Mar kale xisaabi wadarka masaafada iyo wadarka waqtiga.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.explain: Tusaale ahaan, haddii masaafada hal dhinac tahay d, waqtigu waa d/a+d/b xawaaraha celcelisku na waa 2ab/(a+b). (60, 40) waa 48, (40, 10) waa 16, (60, 30) na waa 40. Lammaane kasta oo aad dooratid, xawaaraha celcelisku waa ka yar yahay ama la simanyahay celceliska fudud ee labada xawaare. Wuxuu la simanyahay celceliska fudud kaliya marka labada xawaare isku mid yihiin.
y-m-77-01.s.s3.prompt: U sharax saaxiibkaa shaqo 'sababta celcelisku u ahayn 25 maaha'. U isticmaal waqtiyada tagista iyo soo laabashada sida caddayn, oo ku dar hal weedh oo ku saabsan haddii ay jiraan xaalado celceliska fudud ee labada xawaare uu sax yahay.
y-m-77-01.s.s3.hint.0: Marka hore qor waqtiga tagista iyo waqtiga soo laabashada sida tirooyin.
y-m-77-01.s.s3.hint.1: Isku day inaad ku bilowdo weedh isbarbar dhigaysa waqtiga lagu xisaabiyey 25 (0.96 saacadood) iyo waqtiga dhabta ah ee qaatay.
y-m-77-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma ereyadaada ku sheegtay in waqtiyada tagista iyo soo laabashada ay kala duwan yihiin?
y-m-77-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma bixisay qiimaha laga xisaabiyey wadarka masaafada iyo wadarka waqtiga sida tiro?
y-m-77-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ma sheegtay hal shuruud 'xaaladaha celceliska fudud uu sax yahay'?
y-m-77-01.s.s3.model.0: Xawaaraha celcelisku waa wadarka masaafada loo qaybiyey wadarka waqtiga. Tagistu waxay qaadataa 12÷30=0.4 saacadood soo laabashada na 12÷20=0.6 saacadood, sidaa darteed wadar ahaan waxay qaadataa 1 saacad, darawalkuna wuxuu ku socday 24 km, sidaa darteed waa 24 km/h. Soo laabashadu way gaabisaa, sidaa darteed waqti dheer ayay qaadataa, taasina waa sababta aysan u ahayn 25. Celceliska fudud wuu sax yahay marka labada xawaare isku mid yihiin, ama marka waqtiyada labada lug ay isku mid yihiin.
y-m-77-01.s.s3.model.1: Haddii darawalku ku socdo 25, waxay lahayd inay qaadato 24÷25=0.96 saacadood, laakiin dhab ahaan waxay qaadataa 0.4+0.6=1 saacad. Waqtiga lagu qaatay xawaaraha gaabiska ah wuu ka dheer yahay, sidaa darteed celcelisku waa 24, taasoo ka yar 25. Haddii xawaaraha tagista iyo soo laabashada isku mid ahaan lahaayeen, celceliska fudud wuu sax noqon lahaa.
y-m-77-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Jawaab bixisa shuruudda celceliska fudud inuu sax yahay kaliya 'marka xawaaruhu isku mid yihiin' sidoo kale waa la aqbalaa.

y-m-77-03.title: Kharashka xirista sanduuqa: ma hal xeer ayaa siinaya qiimaha ugu hooseeya?
y-m-77-03.goal: Ku muuji xisaabin in xeerka 'isticmaal sanduuqyo badan oo ka raqiis ah shay kasta intii suurtagal ah' uusan dammaanad qaadayn kharashka ugu hooseeya dalabkan, oo samee dhowr hab xirid oo buuxiya shuruudaha.
y-m-77-03.material: Bakhaar ayaa rabaa inuu u diro 100 qaybood oo loo kala qaybiyey laba nooc oo sanduuq. Sanduuq weyn (L) wuxuu qaadaa ugu badnaan 12 qaybood wuxuuna ku kacaa 1,500 won sanduuq kasta, sanduuq yar (S) na wuxuu qaadaa ugu badnaan 8 qaybood wuxuuna ku kacaa 1,100 won sanduuq kasta. Sanduuqyadu waxay yeelan karaan meel madhan oo haray, laakiin dhammaan 100 qaybood waa in la xiraa. Tiro kasta oo sanduuqyo ah ayaa la isticmaali karaa. Shaqaale ayaa sheegtay kharashka ugu hooseeya sidan.
y-m-77-03.thinking.0: Xukunka haddii xeer (guud-ka-dhigis) uu ansax yahay
y-m-77-03.thinking.1: Samaynta isku-darro xirid oo ah tusaale lid ku ah
y-m-77-03.thinking.2: Helitaanka shuruudaha xeerku si hubaal ah run ugu yahay
y-m-77-03.prereq.1: Qaybsame iyo hadhaaga qaybinta, dheeloobyada toosan (heerka dugsiga dhexe)
y-m-77-03.s.s1.prompt: Dooro hal sadar oo sheegashada shaqaalaha ah oo aan taageero lahayn ama khaldan.
y-m-77-03.s.s1.hint.0: Marka hore naftaada hubi haddii xisaabinta sadarrada 1 iyo 3 ay sax tahay.
y-m-77-03.s.s1.hint.1: Samee dhowr isku-darro oo isticmaala wax ka yar 8 sanduuq oo waaweyn, hubi haddii dhammaan 100 qaybood ay ku habboonaan, oo xisaabi kharashka.
y-m-77-03.s.s1.line.0: Sanduuq weyn wuxuu ku kacaa 1,500÷12 = 125 won shay kasta, sanduuq yar na wuxuu ku kacaa 1,100÷8 = 137.5 won shay kasta.
y-m-77-03.s.s1.line.1: Sidaa darteed, isticmaalka sanduuqyo waaweyn intii suurtagal ah waa ka raqiisan yahay.
y-m-77-03.s.s1.line.2: 100÷12 wuxuu leeyahay qaybsame 8 iyo hadhaag 4, sidaa darteed isticmaal 8 sanduuq oo waaweyn (96 shay) iyo 1 sanduuq yar (4-ka haray).
y-m-77-03.s.s1.line.3: Kharashku waa 1,500×8 + 1,100×1 = 13,100 won, kanina-na waa kharashka ugu hooseeya.
y-m-77-03.s.s1.explain: Xisaabinta qiimaha shay kasta ee khadka 1 iyo xisaabinta qaybta iyo hadhaagga ee khadka 3 waa sax. Khadka 2 wuxuu guud ka dhigay 'shay kasta waa ka rakhiis, sidaas darteed isticmaal inta suurtagalka ah' sabab la'aan. Habka khadka 3, hal sanduuq yar wuxuu leeyahay 4 meelood oo madhan, laakiin haddii aad isticmaasho 7 sanduuq oo waaweyn iyo 2 sanduuq oo yaryar, waxaad buuxinaysaa si sax ah 84+16=100 shay, kharashkuna waa 10,500+2,200=12,700 won. 13,100 won ee khadka 4 ma aha kan ugu hooseeya. Haddii aad dooratay khadka 2 ama khadka 4, waxaad ogaatay khad khaldan.
y-m-77-03.s.s2.prompt: Adigoo isticmaalaya a sanduuq oo waaweyn iyo b sanduuq oo yaryar, samee isku-darka baakadaynta ee qaadi kara 100 qayb ama ka badan oo ka rakhiis ah 13,100 won ee shaqaaluhu sheegay. a iyo b waa tirooyin dhan oo 0 ama ka weyn. Hel laba isku-dar oo kala duwan.
y-m-77-03.s.s2.hint.0: Beddel tirada sanduuqyada waaweyn a ilaa 5, 6, 7, iyo 8, oo hel tirada ugu yar ee sanduuqyada yaryar ee loo baahan yahay si loo qaado 100 shay.
y-m-77-03.s.s2.hint.1: Musharrax kasta, shax ku qor haddii tirada meelaha ay tahay ugu yaraan 100 iyo haddii kharashku ka yar yahay 13,100, oo hubi.
y-m-77-03.s.s2.ok.c1: Tirada sanduuqyada waa tiro dhan oo 0 ama ka weyn.
y-m-77-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Tirada sanduuqyada waa inay noqotaa tiro dhan oo 0 ama ka weyn.
y-m-77-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Dhammaan 100 qayb waa la baakadayn karaa.
y-m-77-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Isku-darkani ma qaadi karo 100 shay. Mar kale tiri meelaha sanduuqyada.
y-m-77-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Kharashku waa 13,100 won ama ka badan. Raadi isku-dar ka rakhiis badan.
y-m-77-03.s.s2.explain: Isku-darrada keliya ee shuruudaha buuxiya waa (7, 2) iyo (5, 5). (7, 2) wuxuu ku baxaa 12,700 won wuxuuna leeyahay si sax ah 100 meel. (5, 5) wuxuu ku baxaa 7,500+5,500=13,000 won wuxuuna leeyahay si sax ah 100 meel. Midna ma laha meel madhan. Habka isticmaalka 8 sanduuq oo waaweyn iyo geliinta inta kale sanduuq yar wuxuu ka tagaa 4 meelood oo madhan sanduuqa yar ee ugu dambeeya.
y-m-77-03.s.s3.prompt: Dalab kee ayaad si hubaal ah ugu odhan kartaa xeerka 'isticmaal sanduuqyada ka rakhiis ah shay kasta inta suurtagalka ah, oo qaybaha hadhay ku dhig sanduuq yar' wuxuu bixiyaa kharashka ugu hooseeya? (Qiimayaasha iyo cabbirrada sanduuqyadu isku mid ayay ahaanayaan.)
y-m-77-03.s.s3.hint.0: Dalab kasta, isbarbar dhig kharashka baakadaynta xeerka iyo kharashka marka aad isticmaasho hal sanduuq weyn oo ka yar iyo sanduuqyo yar oo badan.
y-m-77-03.s.s3.hint.1: Isbarbar dhig dalabaadka xeerku ka tago meelo madhan iyo kuwa uusan ka tagin.
y-m-77-03.s.s3.r.a: Xitaa 98, 7 sanduuq oo waaweyn iyo 2 sanduuq oo yaryar (12,700 won) waa ka rakhiis yihiin 8 sanduuq oo waaweyn iyo 1 sanduuq yar (13,100 won). Kani waa dalab xeerku ku jabo.
y-m-77-03.s.s3.r.b: Meelaha si sax ah ayay ugu habboon yihiin sanduuqyo waaweyn oo keliya, isku-dar aan qiimihiisa meel kastaa ka hooseyn ma jiro, taasina waa aasaaska.
y-m-77-03.s.s3.r.c: Sida aad hadda hubisay, 100 waxaa jira isku-dar ka rakhiis badan waxa xeerku bixiyo.
y-m-77-03.s.s3.o.d: Dalab kasta waa sidaas, si kasta oo qaybaha ay u badan yihiin
y-m-77-03.s.s3.r.d: Si loo yidhaahdo dalab kasta waa run, waa inaad muujisaa in tusaale lid ku ah aanu jirin, laakiin tusaalaha lid ku ah ee 100 horey ayuu u jiray.
y-m-77-03.s.s3.explain: 96 si sax ah ayay ugu habboon yihiin 8 sanduuq oo waaweyn, kharashkuna waa 12,000 won. Isku-dar kasta, qiimaha meel kasta waa ugu yaraan 125 won waxaana lagama maarmaan ah ugu yaraan 96 meel, sidaas darteed kharashku waa ugu yaraan 125×96=12,000 won. Sidaas darteed 12,000 won waa kan ugu hooseeya. Xeerku waa sax dalabaadka sanduuqyada ka rakhiis shay kasta oo keliya si sax ah ugu habboon yihiin (jibaaraha 12), dalabaadka hadhaaga leh-na waxaad u baahan tahay inaad hubiso.

y-m-77-05.title: Marka la sameynayo liis qiimeed leh 'faa'iido 25%', maxaan marka hore weydiinnaa?
y-m-77-05.topic: Aasaaska heerka faa'iidada iyo dejinta qiimaha iibka
y-m-77-05.goal: Ogow in xitaa isla boqolkiiba bixiyo qiime kala duwan iyadoo ku xiran qaddarka uu saami u yahay, oo u qor sida su'aalo aasaaska aad ka hubiso kahor dejinta qiime.
y-m-77-05.material: Dukaan qalab-qoraal ah ayaa rabta inay dejiso qiimaha liiska ee shay kharashkiisu yahay 8,000 won. Hoggaamiyaha kooxdu wuxuu yidhi, 'Fadlan deji qiimaha liiska faa'iido 25% ah.' Faa'iidadu waa faa'iidada qiimaha liiska laga jaray kharashka (qiimaha liiska − kharashka), oo iska dhaaf cashuuraha iyo kharashyada kale. Shaqaalaha 가 ayaa yidhi, 'Ku dar 25% kharashka, sidaas darteed 8,000×1.25=10,000 won.' Shaqaalaha 나 ayaa yidhi, 'Saamiga faa'iidada qiimaha liiska waa inuu noqdaa 25%, sidaas darteed haddii qiimaha liisku yahay P, markaas (P−8,000)÷P=0.25, taasoo ah P≈10,667 won.'

y-m-77-05.thinking.1: Samaynta kiisas halka qiimaha saamigu is beddelo iyadoo ku xiran qaddarka salka ah
y-m-77-05.thinking.2: Qorista fariin weydiinaysa qofka kale macluumaadka loo baahan yahay

y-m-77-05.s.s1.prompt: Waa maxay xukunka ugu habboon ee ku saabsan xisaabaha labada shaqaale?
y-m-77-05.s.s1.hint.0: Hal khad mid kasta ku qor waxa 가 iyo 나 u isticmaaleen '25%' sida saami, oo isbarbar dhig.

y-m-77-05.s.s1.o.a: Xisaabta shaqaalaha 가 waa sax. Boqolkiiba waxaa lagu dhufanayaa kharashka oo lagu darayaa, sidaas darteed isleegga 나 looma baahna
y-m-77-05.s.s1.r.a: Waxaad ka fikirtay kharashka oo keliya. Ma aadan ka fikirin in faa'iidada sidoo kale loo sheegi karo sida saami qiimaha liiska.
y-m-77-05.s.s1.o.b: Xisaabta shaqaalaha 나 waa sax. Heerka faa'iidada had iyo jeer waxaa loo sheegaa sida saami qiimaha liiska, sidaas darteed isleegga 가 waa khalad
y-m-77-05.s.s1.r.b: Waxaad ka fikirtay qiimaha liiska oo keliya. Waa sidoo kale caadi in heerka faa'iidada loo sheego sida saami kharashka.
y-m-77-05.s.s1.o.c: Haddii aan dejinno ku dhawaad 10,333 won, bartamaha labada qiime, wuxuu muujinayaa xisaabaha 가 iyo 나 labadaba
y-m-77-05.s.s1.r.c: Isku darka labada qiime waxay bixisaa qiime aan ku habboonayn qeexid midna. Xaqiiqada ah in salalku kala duwan yihiin lama xalliyo.
y-m-77-05.s.s1.o.d: Labada xisaabba waa sax. Waxaan u baahanahay inaan weydiino hoggaamiyaha kooxda 25% waa saami maxay.
y-m-77-05.s.s1.r.d: Waxaad aqoonsatay in labada xisaabood ay isticmaaleen salal kala duwan, oo marka hore isku dayday inaad xaqiijiso kuwaa salka yahay.
y-m-77-05.s.s1.explain: 가 wuxuu heerka faa'iidada u fasiray sida saami kharashka, 나-na sida saami qiimaha liiska, xisaab kastaana waa sax. 'Faa'iido 25%' keligeed ma dejiso salka kuwaa yahay, sidaas darteed qiimaha liiska looma go'aamiyo hal qiime.
